notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has no page under "Senua's Saga: Hellblade II" or "Hellblade II: Senua's Saga". hellblade.fandom.com has no page under the RAWG title, but has one under "Hellblade II: Senua's Saga" (the Steam store name), with only 3 linked pages ("Hellblade: Senua's Sacrifice", "Ninja Theory" and "Senua (game)"); names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam app used is 2461850, listed in the store as "Hellblade II: Senua’s Saga"; its schema gives the name "Senua’s Saga: Hellblade II". The store list also has an app named just "Senua" (3676410), which was not checked. Only 12 Steam achievements, 8 of them hidden; the hidden ones sit in the main story chapter, and seven of them (3 to 9, unlocked by 46 to 82 percent) look like story progress. "Seeing Things Differently" (11, 15.4 percent) is hidden too and may be something else. The game has few achievement themes, so two chapters hold a single achievement each. RAWG also has a second, undated entry ("senuas-saga-hellblade-ii-2", id 982307); the expected entry (id 398401) was used. RAWG lists Microsoft Game Studios as publisher.
